rationale: VERSION 2.0.0 -> 3.0.0: replaced all-distinct three-to-five-cell toy polyominoes with one or two complete repeated-carrier source lessons.; Added a 28% default-only prior over all five published linked input profiles using only safe reflections, 180-degree rotation, translation, and non-2 color relabeling.; General draws use constructive separated 3x3 slots, source sizes four through six, one unique anchor per source, globally unambiguous target colors, and disjoint destination footprints.; Both the color-2 horizontal-mirror and non-2 preserve branches occur in every large-sample band; mixed scenes occur when two sources use both branches.; Replaced eight lossy or inert controls and three invalid degenerate textures with three exact observable axes: grid_size, n_sources, and n_targets.; Added strict call validation, structural self_check, observe_overrides, independent rule mirror, complete-profile classification, deterministic fresh returns, and RULE_HASH pinning.; Added eight focused regression groups plus independent before/after 30,000-draw censuses and 497-case live Racket parity.
summary: Find every separated 8-connected multicolor source and every isolated singleton. For each source color that occurs exactly once, each singleton of that color requests a copy of the complete source aligned at that unique anchor. Color 2 horizontally mirrors the source's column offsets; every other anchor color preserves both offsets. Sources and markers remain unchanged, and out-of-bounds copy cells are clipped by the executable oracle.
